layout_strategy.grid_mode: MODE B - High Density Accounting Grid
layout_strategy.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8 for containers; gap-4 or gap-6 for metrics widgets
layout_strategy.container_padding: Minimum p-6 internal padding on bordered cards to avoid text collisions
layout_strategy.header_spec: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-50
layout_strategy.card_style: Flat, sharp-cornered or subtle 8px border-radius (rounded-lg) with 1px border-slate-200, no glossy standard gradients

features: KPI Cards: Total Piutang Aktif, Total Hutang Supplier, Arus Kas Bulan Ini (Basis Kas), Laba Margin (Basis Akrual)
Bucket Aging Quick Summary: 0-30 Hari, 31-60 Hari, 61-90 Hari, 90+ Hari
Recent Transaction Stream with status pill badges (Lunas, Parsial, Belum Bayar, Void/Retur)
Quick Action trigger buttons for 'Input Pembayaran Piutang' and 'Input Pembayaran Hutang'
Table with Total Nominal, Terbayar, Sisa Piutang, Status (Lunas / Belum Lunas / Parsial / Retur-Void)
Cicilan Modal Dialog with real-time remaining validation (Anti-Overpayment protection)
Riwayat Pembayaran Drawer / Modal for viewing partial payment log with dates and notes
Retur Kredit Handler setting receivable status to 'Void' (hangus), avoiding false paid inflation
Table with Supplier Name, Invoice No, Total Nominal, Sisa Hutang, Due Date
Partial supplier payment form with payment method (Kas Bengkel, Transfer Bank)
Aging alerts for upcoming due dates (Telat X Hari indicator)

reports_dual_basis.description: Laporan Keuangan Dual Basis (Kas vs Akrual)
features: Laporan Arus Kas (Basis Kas): Pendapatan Kas Aktual - Pembayaran Supplier Aktual - Pengeluaran Operasional
Laporan Margin (Basis Akrual): Omset Penjualan - HPP Modal Barang/Jasa - Pengeluaran Operasional
Category breakdown filter: Spooring, Oli, Ban, Sparepart, Jasa Service
Bagi Laba Pemilik Calculator (Skema Subsidi 50/50 >50jt, Cicilan BNI, Min Laba Ibu 10jt)
Windows XP & Desktop Standalone limitations notice modal/banner with honest technical explanation
Local Database vs Cloud Sync indicators

testing_and_data_attributes.mandatory_rule: Every button, input, select, link, tab, summary metric, status badge, and table row MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

file_structure_guidelines.note: Components in /app/frontend/src use .js syntax (React with JSX standard).

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Never use full-screen transparent headers or drop-downs without solid or blurred backgrounds.
Hover states must always explicitly set background and text colors to preserve legibility.
All monetary amounts must use Indonesian Rupiah formatting (e.g. Rp 1.500.000).
Void/Retur credit items must clearly display a strike-through or muted gray badge with 'Retur/Void' status to ensure non-inflation of paid AR metrics.
Avoid invented or random seeded statistical charts when empty; provide clear Indonesian empty state guidance.
Include responsive layouts that scale gracefully down to mobile screens and up to ultra-wide desktop monitors.
